rows.label: Group-A — Answer any three of the following questions

rows.textLatex: A three phase four wire, $50\text{ Hz}$, $10\text{ km}$ long untransposed line has four wires ($1\text{ cm}$ dia) spaced horizontally $2\text{ m}$ apart in a plane. The wires in order are carrying currents $I_a, I_b$ and $I_c$. The currents are $(-30 + j50)\text{ A}$, $(-25 + j55)\text{ A}$ and $(55 - j105)\text{ A}$. Determine (a) flux linkages of the neutral and voltage induced in the neutral wire, (b) the voltage drop in each of three phase wires.

A three phase $200\text{ km}$ long line has a resistance of $0.05\text{ ohm/km/phase}$, a reactance of $0.4\text{ ohm/km/phase}$ and a capacitive admittance of $j0.5\times 10^{-4}\text{ mho/km/phase}$. Calculate series and shunt parameters of the nominal-$\pi$ and equivalent-$\pi$ circuit for the above line. Which of these two circuits is a more faithful representation of the line? Justify your answer.

rows.topic: Inductance & Capacitance of Symmetrically Spaced 3-Phase Line
rows.textLatex: Derive the expression for inductance and capacitance of a three phase transmission line with symmetrically spaced conductors of radius '$r$' cm. Distance between any of the two conductors is '$D$' m.
Derive expression for the G.M.R of a stranded conductor consisting of seven identical strands. Each strand has $20\text{ cm}$ diameter.

rows.topic: Single-Phase Line Capacitance & Effect of Earth
rows.textLatex: Calculate the phase to neutral capacitance per km of a single phase two wire overhead transmission line. Conductors are spaced $3\text{ m}$ apart horizontally and $7.5\text{ m}$ above the ground. Conductor radius is $0.35\text{ cm}$. Compare the result obtained by neglecting and considering the effect of earth.

rows.topic: Inductance of Transposed Three-Phase Double-Circuit Line
rows.textLatex: Derive expression for the inductance of three phase double circuit line. Assume that the line is evenly transposed.

rows.label: Group-B — Answer any two of the following questions

rows.textLatex: What is characteristic impedance of transmission line? Determine its value for single phase two wire overhead transmission line consisting of solid conductors of circular cross section. What do you mean by SIL of a transmission line?

rows.topic: Travelling Waves on Long Transmission Lines
rows.textLatex: Show that voltage and current at any point of a long transmission line can be resolved into two traveling waves in opposite direction.

rows.topic: Nominal-Pi ABCD Parameters, Sending End Voltage & Loss
rows.textLatex: A three phase $250\text{ km}$ long transmission line has a resistance of $0.05\text{ ohm/km/phase}$, a reactance of $0.4\text{ ohm/km/phase}$ and a capacitive admittance of $j0.5\times 10^{-4}\text{ mho/km/phase}$. Calculate ABCD parameter of the line using nominal-$\pi$ model. Calculate the sending end voltage, line loss if the above line delivers at receiving end a load of $20\text{ MW}$ at $33\text{ kV}$ and at $0.8$ lagging power factor.
